title: A wide sunny view down Crystal Street, a gently curving cul-de-sac of white clapboard two-story houses with black shutters and white picket fences, manicured green lawns, maple trees blazing red and gold, carved pumpkins on every porch step, a kid on a red bicycle and a sprinkler arcing over a lawn, a station wagon in a driveway, soft clear blue sky filling the upper third
